title: Will Jagan claim credit for Polavaram too, questions TDP leader
description: After accusing Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu of stealing credit for the Veligonda project, the YSRCP chief is unable to accept the TDP-led government’s success in taking Godavari water to North Andhra through the Polavaram Left Main Canal, says Neelayapalem Vijay Kumar
